notes: Two ben pairs, each opened by a written between (rule 26); the lamed of each second member takes the and, which rule 26 expressly assigns to it rather than leaving it added, and both waws keep the connectives written for them.
Both light-verb renderings (make a distinction, make ... abominable) head on their complements under rule 44 rather than on make.
All four bracketed assimilated articles are read individually: the two in the ben phrases take written the's, the two before beast and bird are unrepresented (rules 12, 29).
